# White Star Souvenir Works — Titanic Souvenir Viewcard Generator

## About this site
An interactive browser tool that generates a twelve-photo front viewcard and a vintage postcard-style back page, themed around James Cameron's *Titanic* (1997) and Edward John Smith's RMS Titanic (launched 31 May 1909 · sank 15 April 1912).

Built by **Twasin Alam**. Crafted in London, UK. Published under the name Viewcard Studio.

Repository: <https://github.com/twasinalam/titanic-viewcard>
Hosted at: <https://titanic-viewcard.tiiny.site/>

---

## Pages

| URL | Purpose |
|-----|---------|
| `index.html` | Main application studio — drag & drop images onto a 12-slot grid, customise title and quote, select a card template, then print or export. |
| `about.html` | What the studio is, how it works, and privacy commitments. |
| `contact.html` | Bug reports (GitHub Issues) and general inquiries (email). |
| `dedication.html` | Memorial page honouring the 1500 souls lost with the ship. |

---

## How the studio works

1. **Drop images** onto the 12-slot grid. Filenames like `jack`, `rose`, `ismay`, `brady` are auto-matched to character slots via preset logic. Drag any slot to reorder.
2. **Customise text.** Editable title banner and quote field. A memorial footer always renders below the grid.
3. **Pick a template.** Six card templates available for different visual styles.
4. **Print or export.** Renders an A4 sheet through the browser's native Print dialog. All rendering uses the HTML5 Canvas API. Images never leave the machine.

---

## Privacy & technical constraints

- **Client-side only.** Everything runs locally in the browser. No server uploads, no backend, no database.
- **No analytics trackers.** No Google Analytics, no cookie consent banners, no telemetry of any kind.
- **Cookies limited to theme choice.** The only persistent state is `localStorage.tvs-theme` (`dark` or `cream`) so your colour preference carries across pages.
- **Static site.** Four standalone HTML files plus one shared stylesheet (`style.css`). Zero build step, zero dependencies beyond CDN links (Tailwind CSS, Google Fonts, FontAwesome).
- **Dual theme.** Deep navy / amber variant and parchment / vintage-brown variant, both respecting `prefers-color-scheme`.

---

## Character-name presets

The following names map to fixed grid positions when you drop an image whose filename contains them (case-insensitive):

- `jack` → Jack Dawson (Leonardo DiCaprio)
- `rose` → Rose DeWitt Bukater (Kate Winslet)
- `ismay` → Joseph Bruce Ismay (CEO of White Star Line)
- `brady` → Designated slot in the film's narrative timeline
- *(and others matching the film's character roster)*

If a filename doesn't match any preset, the image lands in the first available empty slot.

---

## Design decisions worth knowing

- The studio honours both the real RMS Titanic and James Cameron's 1997 film interpretation. Film-named presets exist alongside historically grounded copy on the dedication page.
- The memorial footer always includes the line *"In Memory of the 1500 Who Went Down with the Titanic"* regardless of which template you choose.
- Print output targets A4 paper at roughly 300 dpi equivalent via the Canvas-to-print pipeline.
